# deepseek-ucs-adapter v0.1.0

First public release. A small, dependency-free bridge between DeepSeek's web export and
[ucs-parser](https://github.com/XwhyZ-WHYLD/universal-cognitive-schema), plus the style card that
turns the resulting profile into usable Agent behaviour.<br>
**中文**：首个公开版本。一个无第三方依赖的转换器，把 DeepSeek 网页版导出接入
[ucs-parser](https://github.com/XwhyZ-WHYLD/universal-cognitive-schema)，并附上把生成的档案
转成 Agent 可执行行为的风格卡片。

## Highlights · 亮点

- **Lossless `fragments[]` → `content.parts[]`** — all eight observed DeepSeek fragment types
  (`REQUEST`, `RESPONSE`, `THINK`, `TOOL_OPEN`, `TOOL_SEARCH`, `TOOL_FIND`, `SEARCH`, `FILE`) are mapped,
  so `ucs-parser` stops returning a near-empty Persona 0.30 / Interaction 0.10 profile.<br>
  **中文**：把实测的 8 种片段类型全部映射到 `content.parts[]`，避免 `ucs-parser` 只抽出
  Persona 0.30 / Interaction 0.10 的空档案。
- **Deterministic UUID v4** — re-running on the same export produces byte-identical output.<br>
  **中文**：对同一份导出重复运行，输出字节级一致。
- **Bilingual CLI** — `--lang zh|en` switches UI text, errors and statistics (default: `zh`).<br>
  **中文**：`--lang zh|en` 切换界面文案、报错与统计（默认 `zh`）。
- **Standard library only** — no runtime dependencies; `pip install` pulls nothing extra.<br>
  **中文**：仅依赖标准库，`pip install` 不会额外拉取任何包。
- **Privacy by construction** — the converter never copies conversation data into build outputs;
  the sdist contains documentation and code only.<br>
  **中文**：构建产物不含任何对话数据，源码包只有文档与代码。

## Assets · 产物

| Asset | Purpose · 用途 |
|---|---|
| `deepseek_ucs_adapter-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl` | Installable distribution exposing the `deepseek-ucs` command<br>可安装分发包，提供 `deepseek-ucs` 命令 |
| `deepseek_ucs_adapter-0.1.0.tar.gz` | Source distribution (code + docs + sanitized example)<br>源码包（代码 + 文档 + 脱敏样例） |
| `SHA256SUMS` | Checksums for both files<br>两个文件的 SHA-256 校验值 |

Verify before use:<br>
**中文**：使用前请校验：

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

## Install · 安装

Requires Python 3.10+.<br>
**中文**：需要 Python 3.10+。

```bash
pip install https://github.com/SunshineMahiru/deepseek-ucs-adapter/releases/download/v0.1.0/deepseek_ucs_adapter-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

Or build from the source archive:<br>
**中文**：或从源码包构建：

```bash
tar -xzf deepseek_ucs_adapter-0.1.0.tar.gz
cd deepseek_ucs_adapter-0.1.0
python -m build
```

## Container image (GitHub Packages) · 容器镜像

The same wheel is published as an OCI image:<br>
**中文**：同一个 wheel 也以 OCI 镜像形式发布：

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/sunshinemahiru/deepseek-ucs-adapter:0.1.0

# mount the directory that holds conversations.json / 挂载存放 conversations.json 的目录
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/work" ghcr.io/sunshinemahiru/deepseek-ucs-adapter:0.1.0 \
  conversations.json conversations_chatgpt.json
```

## Usage · 用法

```bash
deepseek-ucs conversations.json conversations_chatgpt.json
```

Then generate the profile exactly as documented in the README:<br>
**中文**：随后按 README 中的方式生成档案：

```bash
python -c "from ucs_parser import Parser; r = Parser(source='chatgpt').from_file('conversations_chatgpt.json'); r.to_json('my_profile.ucs.json'); print(r.fidelity_report())"
```

## Compatibility · 兼容性

- Python 3.10+; the 0.1.0 wheel is built and smoke-verified on CPython 3.12, with no third-party imports.<br>
  **中文**：Python 3.10+；0.1.0 的 wheel 在 CPython 3.12 上构建并完成安装与运行冒烟验证，无第三方依赖。
- Output targets ucs-parser v0.1.0, which accepts ChatGPT mapping format only.<br>
  **中文**：输出面向 ucs-parser v0.1.0，该版本只接受 ChatGPT mapping 格式。

## Known limitations · 已知限制

- `ucs-parser` hardcodes `language_preferences` to `"en"`; Chinese detection is not implemented upstream.<br>
  **中文**：`ucs-parser` 上游把 `language_preferences` 硬编码为 `"en"`，未做中文识别。
- Interaction-pattern fidelity has a structural ceiling (~0.41) on Chinese corpora because explicit
  correction markers are rare in the measured 2,856-message sample.<br>
  **中文**：中文语料的交互模式分数存在结构性上限（约 0.41），原因是 2,856 条实测样本中显式纠正标记极少。
- Fragment handling covers the eight types observed so far; new DeepSeek fragment types will need
  an extension in a future minor release.<br>
  **中文**：片段处理仅覆盖目前观测到的 8 种类型，新增类型需在后续小版本中扩展。
